get.description: Returns the current user profile. Supports JWT session, user API Key (grape_) or session token (tk_).

post.description: Logs out: increments token_version to revoke all tokens and clears the refresh cookie.

get.description: Lists repositories the current user can operate. Reads the user_repos cache, auto-refreshing from GitCode when empty or stale; prunes managed repos removed upstream.

post.description: Manually syncs the repository list from VCS, refreshes the user_repos cache and probes/cleans stale managed records.

get.description: Checks whether a repository with the same name already exists under the current user.

post.description: Creates a repository via the VCS API; optionally auto-hosts it afterwards.
Registers an existing repository for hosting: creates the webhook and sets up the repo bot.
Self-heals an unfinished hosting flow (bot not joined / webhook missing). Idempotent; uses owner-token invite + bot-token webhook, skipping the invite when the bot is already a maintainer.

get.description: Lists repositories hosted by the platform for the current user.
Returns whether the repository has a bound DevOps bot token.

put.description: Sets the repository DevOps bot token and automatically adds the repo bot as a maintainer.
Registers the deployed access URL of the business system.

get.description: Returns the repository deployment access URL.

post.description: Removes hosting for a repository (unregisters webhook/bot bindings).

get.description: Reads the authoritative project-knowledge baseline for a repository: files (full text) + meta (commit/branches/updated/degraded). Dual: user (JWT/API key) and session token (tk_, repo scope must match).
Reads the repository smart scene-recommend config (fallback scene + routing rules).

put.description: Saves the repository scene-recommend config. Self-checks on write: filters out rules whose scene_id is not in the current scene list; fallback_scene is required.

get.summary: One-shot git platform credential (CLI internal, TTL)
get.description: One-shot short-lived platform credential for local git via CLI (in-process, never persisted). gitcode uses Basic auth with username x-access-token and the configured gitcode token as password. Session-only.

get.summary: Repository workspace path (local git via CLI)
get.description: Returns the grape-managed local workspace path for the repository (CLI local git on the server). Session-only.
Repository metadata from the Git provider: id/name/full_name/default_branch/html_url/clone_url/visibility.
Lists repository branches from the Git provider (paged).
Lists the repository commit history from the Git provider.
Repository directory tree. Single-level (default) proxies git/trees/{ref}; depth=recursive is GitHub-only (GitCode rejects it). ref empty resolves the default branch.
Repository root directory listing (empty path returns the GitCode root array).

get.summary: Repository contents: dir listing or file content (base64)
get.description: Repository contents via the Git provider: empty/root or directory returns an entry list; a file returns base64 content.
Lists repository labels.

post.description: Creates a repository label (name required, color optional).

get.description: Lists repository milestones (state filter).
Lists repository issues (state open/closed/all filter, paged).

post.description: Creates an issue (title/body/assignee).

get.description: Returns a single issue.

post.description: Closes an issue on the Git provider. Provider-adapted: GitHub PATCH state=closed; GitCode PATCH state=close with the required repo/title (title auto-fetched). Returns the updated issue, or 502 if the provider does not apply the close.

get.description: Lists comments on an issue.

post.description: Creates a comment on an issue (body required).

get.description: Lists repository pull requests (state filter, paged).

post.description: Creates a pull request (title/head/base). Provider-adapted: gitcode inner_issue_nums; github Closes #N body.

get.description: Returns a single pull request.

put.description: Merges a pull request; returns {merged, sha}.

get.description: Lists PR inline comments.

post.description: Creates a PR comment (body required).

get.description: Lists files changed in a pull request.

get.description: Event detail with payload/agent_logs/result for a seq.

get.description: Returns the event conversation thread messages.

delete.description: Clears the event conversation thread records.

post.description: Sends a message into the event conversation (non-streaming).

delete.description: Deletes agent knowledge produced for the event (file + DB + refs).

post.description: SSE streaming conversation. Direct mode streams live; queue mode returns a single done.
Submits a conversation query and immediately returns a task_id; the agent executes in the background.

get.description: Queries conversation task status (memory first, DB fallback).
Subscribes to conversation task SSE output (buffered replay + live append).
Paged event list for a repository with optional filters.
Lists conversations (optionally filtered by repo_key).

post.description: Creates a new chat conversation for a repo_key.

delete.description: Deletes a conversation and its messages.

get.description: Lists messages of a conversation (limit/before pagination).

post.description: Sends a chat message and returns the full assistant reply (text/structured).
Sends a chat message over SSE: data:{delta} ... then data:{done}.
Submits feedback on a chat turn (seq + type + comment).

get.description: Returns chat config (backend/settings/personal engines).

put.description: Updates chat config.

post.description: Submits a chat query and immediately returns {task_id, conversation_id, status}; the agent runs in the background.

get.description: SSE subscribe to task output: replays the buffer then appends live events; DB fallback for finished tasks.

post.description: Async message send: DB/engine work runs in executors. Local engines return a fallback stream; remote engines return task_id.

put.description: Updates third-party credentials; placeholder/demo values are rejected.

get.description: Lists the current user's API keys without plaintext (name + status + timestamps only).

post.description: Generates a grape_-prefixed API key. Plaintext is returned exactly once; the DB stores the SHA-256 hash.

delete.description: Revokes an API key (soft delete, revoked=1); takes effect immediately and keeps audit.

put.description: Updates the GitCode OAuth client config.

Legacy alias for refreshing agent runtimes.

get.description: Lists runtime credentials without token_hash/plaintext.

put.description: Renames a credential (worker name); globally unique, duplicates rejected. owner/scope unchanged.

post.description: Revokes and deletes a worker credential: removes the credential row and cascades its agent_runtimes; runtime_session bindings are reset.

get.description: Returns the current execution mode.

get.description: Lists an engine's tags.

delete.description: Deletes an event action filter rule (no rules = allow all).

post.description: Toggles a skill like.

put.description: Updates a scene (repo/user scope directly; official immutable).

delete.description: Deletes a custom scene (soft delete; official undeletable).

post.description: Applies a scene to a repository.
